user.description: Select the Run-Chicken door to add.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the Run-Chicken door {name}?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Make sure the door is powered on and within Bluetooth range, then try again.

abort.not_run_chicken_device: The discovered device is not a Run-Chicken door.

data.poll_on_schedule: Without persistent connection: poll only after scheduled opening/closing
data.poll_interval: Poll interval (minutes), used when polling on schedule is off
data.record_raw_bytes: Record raw door data to a file

data_description.persistent_connection: On: the door reports state changes instantly, but staying connected uses more battery. Off: Home Assistant connects briefly every poll interval and for open/close commands, then disconnects; state changes the door makes on its own show up at the next poll.
data_description.poll_on_schedule: Connects ~3 min after each scheduled operation and for commands from Home Assistant (in manual mode once a day). Every connection makes the door play its tune and light its LED. Off: poll on the interval below.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to connect and read state and battery when the persistent connection is off (5-60).
data_description.record_raw_bytes: When enabled, every raw message exchanged with the door (received and sent) is appended (timestamp + RX/TX + base64) to a run_chicken_[address].log file in your Home Assistant config folder. Attach that file when reporting an issue. Leave off for normal use.
